questions.question: A boat travels 42 km downstream in 3 hours. If the speed of the stream is 4 km/h, find the speed of the boat in still water.
questions.explanation: Downstream speed = 42/3 = 14 km/h = boat + stream. Boat = 14 − 4 = 10 km/h.
